description: Get the URL for a book's cover image using a key (ISBN, OCLC, LCCN, OLID, ID) and value. Reports when no cover exists rather than returning a URL to a blank placeholder.

key.description: The type of identifier used (ISBN, OCLC, LCCN, OLID, ID). ID is Open Library's internal cover ID.

size.description: The desired size of the cover (S, M, or L). Defaults to L.

name: get_book_cover
title: Get book cover URL
